Your service's own log will show that one next to the browser's navigation - it is dhole dialing, not the page. · the target is loopback/private, so the browser tier navigated without dhole's invented google referer. What that browser sends of its own (UA, `sec-ch-ua*`, `sec-fetch-*`) arrived as it always does, plus every header you named · 1 of 1 actions did not take effect (read '#status': the selector matched no element (or none became actionable) before the timeout: Locator.inner_text: Timeout 10000ms exce)
next_action: these interactions never happened, so the content is the page BEFORE them - check each failed selector against a fresh copy of the page and retry just that action (metadata.actions lists one row per action)
